tagline: Compare uPVC double glazing quotes from vetted local fitters

faq.question: What does uPVC double glazing cost in the UK?
faq.answer: As a rough guide from typical UK market rates: a standard uPVC casement window runs from about £350 to £900 fitted, sash-style windows from about £600 to £1,100, and a bay window from about £1,200 to £3,200 depending on size and spec. Regional labour rates move these figures. A free quote gives you the real number for your property.

faq.question: Is it actually free to compare quotes?
faq.answer: Yes, it's free for homeowners. Installers pay us a small fee when we pass them a quote request, so there's no charge to you and no reason for us to favour one firm over another.

faq.question: Who are the installers?
faq.answer: Independently-run local window and door firms. FENSA (or equivalent competent-person scheme) registration is one of the checks we make before a firm joins the network.

faq.question: How many installers will contact me?
faq.answer: Up to three, so you have something to compare. You're never obliged to accept any of the quotes.
